defs.def: a unit for measuring length; a 1 000th of a metre 毫米；千分之一米

ex.s: Imagine bone-white coral 6,000 metres below the ocean’s surface, growing at the rate of only one or two millimetres per year.
ex.t: 想象一下，在海面以下六千米处，骨白色的珊瑚以每年仅一两毫米的速度生长。

ex.s: The Great Blizzard of 1888 Date: ,1888 Areas affected: (2) of the United States Snowfall: millimetres in some places metres thick in some places Damage: More than (5) people died in total.
ex.t: 1888年大暴风雪 日期：1888年 受影响地区：美国（2） 降雪量：某些地方 毫米 某些地方 米厚 损失：总共超过（5）人死亡。

ex.s: Nowadays, the fine sharp needles that measure usually between 15 and 75 millimetres in length are still used, while most of the others have been replaced by more complex medical instruments.
ex.t: 如今，那些长度通常在15到75毫米之间的细尖针仍在使用，而其他大多数已被更复杂的医疗器械所取代。
